set.body: Expose locus spaces from finite spatial domains, strengthen surface topology checks, rename the spatial bounding box to VoxelBox, and lower regions or selections into lazy demands without replacing spatial.Field. Attach semantic identity to resolved dataset domains, preserve All versus AllSpatial policy, requested order, and active-to-full-grid injection semantics. Acceptance follows phase 8 of docs/plans/finite-indexed-spaces.md with spatial and dataset JVM and Scala.js gates.
set.title: Locus 8: integrate spatial and dataset selection boundaries
